latestVersion.changelog:
ArbiScan 0.2.0 - Expanded crypto market scanning and monitoring

- Scans across Binance, OKX, Bybit, and Bitget with 12 scan types: arbitrage, market monitoring, and trading signals
- Maps common user questions directly to appropriate scans for fast, relevant insights
- Enforces correct symbol formats per exchange for reliable data
- Robust error handling: processes partial results if some exchanges/symbols are unavailable
- Read-only scanner—no trading or API keys required
- New capabilities include funding rate and basis arbitrage, spot and futures spreads, open interest, price and volume anomalies, funding trends, depeg detection, and new listings
